GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091 (12 Jun 46) GB/CIS
(SCAPIN-1016)
APO 500
12 June 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Non-eviction of German Nationals from Homes now Occupied.
1. Pending their repatriation, no German national now living in leased residence will be evicted from such residence by virtue of termination of lease, without the prior approval of General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
2. In the cases of German nationals who may be permitted by this headquarters to remain in Japan, the foregoing applies only until such time as the decision has been made exempting them from evacuation. Thereafter their housing arrangements will be a matter concerning the individuals and their landlords.
3. The instructions contained herein will not be construed to preclude the requisition by Occupation Forces of Japanese residences now occupied by German nationals.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
